messages.subject: RE: [dartR] Re: gl. structure problem
parts:
Hi,

 

These are older versions can you run please:

 

 

dartRverse::dartRverse_install(“dartR.base“, “ github“, “dev“)

dartRverse::dartRverse_install(“dartR.popgen“, “ github“, “dev“)

 

 

and if still fail also do that for all other packages (except dartR.data)

 

you should have version >=0.88 for all packages

 

 

Cheers, Bernd
